role: external action in the 1989 metareasoning presentation
notes: An action in the world; distinct from an executable computational block.

role: computational action in the 1989 source notation
notes: A complete computation commits to action; a partial computation leaves another choice.

role: completed history and possible future complete computation trace
notes: Dot concatenation joins computational traces; a future trace is contingent on observed computation outcomes.

role: situation resulting from a specified action in the source notation
notes: The omitted initial situation is understood; both external and computational actions may occur.

role: actual external utility and a computation-stage estimate
notes: The evaluation snapshot is explicit; a heuristic estimate is not automatically calibrated.

role: current external intention after computation history S
notes: A stated tie rule selects the named action whose current estimate is largest.

role: external action recommended by complete computation c
notes: The action maximizes the new estimate vector; named actions can index their vector coordinates.

role: metalevel information summary available to the computation controller
notes: Contains declared input or workspace features clock memory and retained computation results.

role: actual executable-block transition on a modeled machine configuration
notes: Includes execution output running time and peak memory; deterministic execution may have an uncertain predicted result.

role: map from modeled machine configurations to controller summaries
notes: Compression must retain a sufficient transition cost feasibility and stopping model.

role: finite class of modeled problem instances and one instance
notes: May include unresolved configuration or physical random-bit uncertainty; does not create randomness in a deterministic calculation.

role: conditional predictive instance weights at a metalevel summary
notes: A population or subjective computation model; zero-probability successors require no posterior quotient.

role: successor-summary kernel induced by an executable computation model
notes: Its definition groups the actual program-transition outputs by their summaries.

role: joint vector of post-computation intrinsic estimates and its predictive distribution
notes: Several changing estimates need a joint law; subtree independence means one changed component.

role: one-step estimated net value of a complete computation
notes: Compares new and old intentions using the same later estimate then charges the declared common delay cost once.

role: positive part of a real scalar in computation-benefit formulas
notes: Defined as the maximum of x and zero.

role: finite set of resource-feasible executable blocks at summary z
notes: May be empty; a deadline or memory violation excludes a block.

role: model expected external payoff of committing to the implemented intention
notes: The stopping value does not optimize an uncomputed true-utility table.

role: expected direct resource cost of one executable block
notes: Delay belongs either to the time-dependent stopping payoff or to a separable cost; it is charged only once.

role: optimal remaining-budget value and first-computation continuation value
notes: At budget zero the external stopping payoff grounds the backward recursion.

role: stopping probability conditional computation policy and predicted policy return
notes: This models the actual controller without assuming that its choices are optimal.

role: approximate optimal-continuation scores and their uniform error bounds
notes: The policy-loss theorem requires an established bound at every state and remaining budget.

role: additional action-independent utility cost of using the computation controller
notes: This is additional to the direct costs of the chosen computation blocks.

role: input-bit pair and the two priced executable blocks in the worked program
notes: Bits are already in input memory; loading and evaluating them are computation actions not new external measurements.
